content.en:
Hi, my name is Matt Gray. I came here as a doctor.
It was supposed to be a simple trip, but now...

I don't know why you're here but you should turn around.
Get out of here.

If you choose to stay here, you're up for no fun.

I sense an evil presence
That cemetery has something evil
I really want to go back
but that thing is following me.

content.es:
Encontraste un error!
Deberia de haber una nota aqui...
content.en: You encountered an error! There should be a note here...

I lost one of the patients, she was a sweet girl.

The people in this town are insane.
They don't care for safety.
They only care for, sacrifices?
